current.role_interpretation: leaning toward a specific pilot structure

source_evidence.text: I am leaning toward a four-month nonexclusive pilot limited to service and explanatory stories, with our approval of every feed headline, story-level distribution and correction logs, and no homepage widget.

source_evidence.text: I will tell the board we should describe it as a distribution test, not an institutional endorsement, and that investigations remain outside the evidence it can produce.

qualification.role_interpretation: counterpressure that could change or limit the current position
